_comment: Don't hand-write this. Install the Homebridge Dummy plugin, open its config UI (the wrench/Settings on the plugin card) and add a momentary switch named 'HomePod Logger Trigger' with a 1-second auto-reset. The UI writes a 'platforms' block like the one below. If you enable 'Child Bridge' in the UI, Homebridge also adds a per-install '_bridge' section (username/port) automatically — leave whatever it generates untouched. The older accessory form ({"accessory":"DummySwitch",...}) did NOT expose a usable momentary switch here; use the platform form below.
name: HomePod Logger Trigger
